Hello Team,

I’m writing to keep our passenger experience steady and clear. Aurelia Skyways passengers who travel with pets should feel guided from start to finish, without surprises. When a coordinator outlines the required travel steps, we follow through with patient attention from trained staff at every handoff.

The onboard handler for the Starling is Bela Thorn. That assignment is the backbone of smooth in-cabin care, so please treat it as the single source of truth for who manages pets on board.

For the traveler, like Yara Bianchi or Andre Larsen, the best outcome comes when we confirm needs early, document details accurately, and communicate calmly. Please remember Stella’s comfort and wellbeing should drive our timing, restraint, and check-ins, especially when schedules shift.

Let’s tighten our internal notes and reinforce consistency across the desk. If anything looks uncertain, flag it immediately so we can protect the experience passengers come to us for.

Customer Advocate Companion Animal Travel Desk
